use.flag: Enable X11 display server support

Pull in sys-apps/ai-jail and start the Claude agents of a project inside it: a writable project, network limited to the hosts allowed, memory, CPU, process and disk limits, and a home and Claude login of its own per project

Install the claude-agent-acp-plus ACP agent and apply source patches that force-enable the acp-beta feature flag plus agent panel UI improvements: multiline elicitation fields, collapsible markdown option previews, a manual-mode badge, clickable file mentions in replayed messages, and adoption of the agent's config-option response; also makes a thread menu choice (permission mode, model, thinking effort, agent config option) apply to that thread only, with Shift to make it the default for new threads
Install the claude-agent-acp-tui ACP bridge to run the Claude Code TUI in the agent panel
Native Claude Code CLI editor integration (unofficial reverse-engineered IDE protocol, WebSocket MCP server) via a source patch

Apply a source patch that adds zeo-browser-host, the native-messaging host the zeo-browser extension uses to show and drive the same agent thread from a browser sidebar, and install its Chrome and Chromium manifests; the extension itself is installed unpacked from zeo-workspace/zeo-browser (needs devtools-bridge)

Apply a source patch that gives the zeo-devtools panel page devtools threads of its own project, adds the `devtools: start`, `devtools: stop` and `devtools: open in browser` actions, and a badge and "Devtools threads only" filter in the thread list (needs browser-extension)
Apply a source patch that adds a read-only Epic Stories dock panel listing the project's .epico/ stories with their status and tasks.md progress, updated live (needs claude-agent-acp-plus)

Apply a source patch that adds the devtools bridge: a unix socket under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR that the zeo-devtools Vite plugin uses to put an element clicked in the dev page into the agent composer (needs claude-agent-acp-plus)
Build and install zeo-extension, Zed's command-line tool for writing and packaging extensions
Build the GPUI UI inspector, which shows the element tree, layout and styles of the interface at run time
Use mimalloc as the global memory allocator for improved performance
Enable Neovim integration for full vim compatibility via RPC
Build and install zeo-remote-server in /usr/libexec, which Zeo uploads to a remote host (SSH or a dev container) that has no server of its own; built in a separate run so it does not link X11
Enable screen capture support (Zed's screen sharing)
Pull in net-libs/nodejs, which the editor prefers over downloading a Node runtime of its own
Keep Zed's usage reports (diagnostics and metrics sent to api.zed.dev) on by default; without it both default to off
Enable Tracy profiler integration for performance analysis

Apply a source patch that adds voice input to the agent composer: a microphone button and ctrl-alt-v (tap to toggle, hold to talk) record speech and whisper.cpp transcribes it on this machine into the composer, unsent; pulls in app-accessibility/whisper-models for the default speech model, and a remote OpenAI-compatible service is opt-in, off by default (needs claude-agent-acp-plus)
Enable Wayland display server support

pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Zeo is the Zed editor carrying the bentoo patch series - the Claude agent integrations and the agent-panel changes built on them - with a distinct identity of its own: name, icon, release channel, application binary, URL scheme and state directories. It is built from a snapshot of Zed's main branch named by EGIT_COMMIT and versions itself; app-editors/zed builds upstream's releases unpatched.
Exactly one of app-editors/zed, zed-bin, zeo and zeo-bin is installed at a time. app-editors/zeo-bin is this package prebuilt for x86-64-v3.
The collab, extensions-cli and remote-server flags app-editors/zed offers are absent here: each installs a binary under a Zed name.
